newsitem.title: NORWAY: Fokus board rejects takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: Fokus board rejects takeover bid.

text.p: Norway's Fokus Bank on Monday recommended its shareholders to turn down a take-over bid by Sparebankgruppen and did not rule out other bids may come soon.
The board said plans by Sparebankgruppen to divide up the business of Fokus among the various regional savings banks would have negative consequences for Fokus's clients and employees.

Analysts believe a foreign bidder, possibly a Swedish or Danish bank, might rescue Fokus from Sparebankgruppen, which last Wednesday said it controled 25.13 percent of the stock in Fokus through options and share acquisitions.
Fokus is 80 percent owned by foreign investors.
